aboutGame.title: What is Idle Breakout?
paragraphs: Idle Breakout is an addictive incremental arcade game that reinvents the classic Atari breakout formula with deep idle progression. Players smash through numbered geometric bricks, earn cash for every shattered block, and build an automated fleet of bouncing spheres ranging from rapid-fire Scatter balls to toxic Poison spheres.

As stage numbers climb toward level 1000 and beyond, brick durability scales into millions and billions of hit points. Progression demands strategic stat balancing across power, velocity, and spatial coverage, paired with timely prestige resets that convert hard-fought stages into permanent account-wide multipliers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Idle Breakout mechanics, balls, codes, and prestige.

items.question: What is Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Idle Breakout is an incremental brick-breaking game where players smash numeric blocks to earn cash, purchase automated balls, unlock powerful upgrades, and climb past level 1000 using prestige resets.

items.question: What are the best balls to upgrade in Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Plasma Balls and Poison Balls are top-tier in Idle Breakout for their devastating area-of-effect damage and percentage-based health drainage. Scatter Balls provide excellent screen coverage for clearing stray blocks.

items.question: How do codes work in Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Idle Breakout codes are encrypted save import strings rather than promotional text vouchers. You can import them via the Settings gear menu to load specific progress states, test end-game builds, or activate autoplay configurations.

items.question: When should I prestige in Idle Breakout?
items.answer: You should prestige in Idle Breakout whenever stage progression slows down noticeably and bricks take dozens of hits to shatter. Your first prestige is typically recommended between stages 200 and 300 to claim permanent skill points.

items.question: Where can I play Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Idle Breakout is freely playable on web platforms like Coolmath Games, itch.io, and mobile browsers on iOS and Android devices without requiring any download.
